workData.title: Wood Processing Enterprise Mobile System
workData.description: Engineered a cross-platform mobile system to digitize wood production workflows, improving operational visibility and reducing manual reporting.

caseStudy.overview: A mobile-first operations system for timber processing activities, replacing fragmented paper logs and manual recap spreadsheets used by production supervisors.
caseStudy.problem: Production data was recorded manually and synchronized at the end of shifts, causing delays, data mismatch, and low visibility for management.
goals: Capture production events in real time from shop-floor operators
Reduce manual recap and duplicate input between departments
Provide daily production progress and bottleneck visibility
responsibilities: Built Flutter mobile modules for production input and approvals
Designed and implemented REST API integration with Node.js backend
Optimized SQL Server query flows for faster dashboard response
Worked with production team to refine data validation rules
caseStudy.architecture: Mobile Flutter clients communicate with Node.js REST services, backed by SQL Server for transactional production data and reporting aggregation.
keyFeatures: Material usage and output tracking per process stage
Supervisor approval flow with audit trail
impact: Reduced reporting lag from end-of-day to near real-time input
Lowered manual recap workload for production admin team

challenges.title: Unstable network in factory areas
challenges.solution: Implemented retry strategy and resilient request handling for unreliable connectivity.

challenges.title: Inconsistent operator input format
challenges.solution: Added strict form validation and constrained selectable values by workstation.

workData.title: Plastic Manufacturing Operational App
workData.description: Developed a production monitoring mobile application enabling real-time tracking of manufacturing activities and enhancing data accuracy across departments.

caseStudy.overview: Operational mobile app for plastic manufacturing lines that unifies production updates, quality checkpoints, and shift handover notes in one system.
caseStudy.problem: Each line tracked activity in separate spreadsheets and messaging groups, making production status and quality events hard to consolidate.
goals: Standardize production and quality data collection
Provide one source of truth for shift performance
Improve handover quality between morning and night shifts
responsibilities: Developed core Flutter screens for production and QC flow
Implemented role-based access and screen-level permissions
Integrated mobile app with Express.js APIs
Supported user acceptance testing with line supervisors
caseStudy.architecture: Flutter mobile frontend consumes Express.js APIs with SQL Server storage, with role-based data access to separate operator, QC, and supervisor views.
keyFeatures: Real-time production status update per machine line
QC checkpoint recording with issue tagging
Shift handover note and pending action list
Alert indicator for abnormal production patterns
impact: Increased consistency of production and QC records
Reduced communication gaps during shift transitions
Accelerated supervisor review for line issues

challenges.title: Different workflow across production lines
challenges.solution: Designed configurable forms and status mapping per line type.

challenges.title: Resistance to replacing spreadsheet habits
challenges.solution: Introduced progressive rollout and training with parallel run period.

workData.title: Maintenance Management System
workData.description: Architected a mobile-first maintenance platform that streamlined equipment tracking, reduced downtime, and improved preventive maintenance workflows.

caseStudy.overview: A maintenance platform focused on preventive scheduling and fast issue handling for production equipment in a multi-department manufacturing environment.
caseStudy.problem: Maintenance tickets were tracked manually and often reacted too late, resulting in repeated machine downtime and unclear responsibility follow-up.
goals: Digitize maintenance request and assignment flow
Give management visibility on downtime and response time
responsibilities: Implemented mobile ticketing and maintenance task modules
Integrated microservice endpoints for work order lifecycle
Designed notification and escalation behavior for overdue jobs
Aligned data model with maintenance and operations stakeholders
caseStudy.architecture: Flutter mobile app integrates with Node.js microservices for ticketing, scheduling, and notifications, with SQL Server for core records and historical analytics.
keyFeatures: Maintenance ticket creation with priority classification
Work order assignment and progress tracking
impact: Shortened response cycle for high-priority machine issues
Provided clearer ownership across maintenance tasks

challenges.title: Complex approval flow between departments
challenges.solution: Introduced explicit status transitions and owner handoff rules.

challenges.title: Notification overload for non-critical issues
challenges.solution: Added priority-based notification throttling and escalation rules.
